notes: Uncategorized spends from common merchants (Swiggy, Amazon, Netflix, Uber, etc.) now get categorized automatically from day one. Analytics shows an "Other" slice instead of silently dropping smaller categories. Family Sharing's Transactions tab now lets you delete a shared expense. Investments can now be added as a real mutual fund (search + auto-synced NAV), not just a manual number - stocks/FDs still manual. Privacy policy updated to disclose everything it was missing (location/contacts permissions, document storage, in-app updater).
